'''Tenga Javik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] survivor of the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]]. She became a community leader of sorts near the ruins of what was once the [[Catier Walkway]]. The "[[Walkway Collective]]" survived by producing [[grayweave]] for sustenance and fighting the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] patrols using guerrilla tactics.

Tenga survived long enough to meet with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] special forces team sent to investigate Coruscant and set up resistance cells.
